hook.name: ShardHookV1
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that owns permanently-locked single-sided SHARD token liquidity across full-range and concentrated band positions. It enables NFT minting and burning via pool buys and sells, charges a 1% fee on all swaps (via hook callbacks for third-party swaps and explicitly for hook-initiated swaps), and distributes fees proportionally to NFT holders.
